The Democrats’ shutdown gambit exposes their twisted priorities: sacrificing programs like WIC—which serves American mothers and children—to protect healthcare loopholes for illegal immigrants. The America First Act (S.62) explicitly restricts federal benefits to non-citizens, closing the very loopholes Democrats now fight to preserve.

WIC’s potential collapse isn’t about funding—it’s about Democrats weaponizing taxpayer-funded healthcare for illegals as a bargaining chip. Medicaid fraud and bureaucratic bloat already drain billions, while millions added through asylum, parole, and deferred action schemes compound the strain.

Every dollar diverted to non-citizens is stolen from citizens who paid into the system. Real “America First” policy means cutting the waste, enforcing the law, and putting taxpayers—not globalist handouts—first.
